text:
julia_se: Heads up, NewBridge sent back their RFI. Main asks: POC scope + timeline, a filled security questionnaire (they attached), and pricing for a 1-month reserved evaluation. They also want to know if we can do customer-managed keys and a per-route cost export during the eval.

owen_salesops: Roger. Do we have a standard "1-month reserved eval" SKU? If not, propose bands. Also request their expected QPS and peak tokens/day.

rachel_solution: Proposal idea: 4-week POC, staging mirror in our Dedicated pool (1x A10G equivalent), set up prefix caching and a warmed KV cache. Eval harness with: 1) 95th-latency suite; 2) throughput ramp; 3) regression prompts. Success criteria: p95 latency < 80ms (can tighten to 50ms if they accept auto-batching), throughput >= 300 reqs/min with <1% error, and no significant semantic drift on control prompts.

sam_security: On CMK/HSM: Hosted supports customer-managed keys via our KMS adapter for major cloud KMS (AWS, GCP, Azure). For an on-prem HSM, we'd need a Private deployment + HSM integration window. Can we ask if they require key import or remote wrap only?

julia_se: I'll ask them to confirm vendor and whether keys must never leave their HSM.

owen_salesops: Pricing bands (draft):
- Hosted PAYG: standard token rates + metering; estimate $0.02/token generation for heavy gen (placeholder)
- 1-month Reserved Eval (Dedicated node): $12k flat + metered tokens
- Private (on-prem): $35k one-time deploy + $5k/mo support retainer
These are drafts. Need legal for contract addendum if HSM is involved.

legal_bot: FYI: if HSM/in-place key custody is required, we need an addendum limiting key access, and an indemnity clause for key compromise during the POC. I'll draft a short clause.

rachel_solution: Also request network diagram and expected egress (GB/day). For peered VPC we require CIDR ranges and a test VPN window. I'll add a minimal checklist to the response:
```
- Provide sample 1-hour trace and QPS profile
- Confirm HSM vendor + model + access pattern (remote wrap / PKCS11)
- Provide peering/VPN details (CIDRs, firewalls)
- Identify SAML/SCIM identity provider for user access during POC
- Approve telemetry retention and read-only Console token
```

sam_security: We should attach our completed security questionnaire template and mark any "TBD" rows where HSM specifics are missing.

julia_se: Good call. Owen can you assemble the pricing slide + capability matrix? They want a single Excel mapping our features to their RFP requirements (HSM, SOC2, SLOs, on-prem).

owen_salesops: On it. I'll include a column for "POC available now" vs "Requires Private deployment" and note expected lead times.

infra_bot: Uploaded: newbridge_rfi_2026-03-10.pdf (2.4 MB)

legal_bot: Draft addendum saved: newbridge_hsm_addendum_v1.docx. Will attach to next email.

rachel_solution: Quick connectivity check snippet to include in the packet (ask them to run and paste output):
```bash
curl -sS https://status.redwood.example.com/check -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | jq .status
```

julia_se: Timeline constraint: they asked for POC start in 6 business days. We can meet that only if they return network/HSM details within 48 hours and sign the addendum. Otherwise push.

sam_security: Also confirm which compliance artifacts they want (SOC2, ISO27001, PCI?). We have SOC2 report and ISO summary; FedRAMP is not in scope.

owen_salesops: I'll draft the one-pager capability matrix + pricing and post in this thread by EOD. Rachel will add the security questionnaire and checklist.

rachel_solution: Uploaded draft: newbridge_capability_matrix_draft.xlsx and newbridge_poc_onepager.pdf

julia_se: Thanks team. I'll send initial reply to buyer asking for HSM vendor + 1-hour trace + peering details and attach our matrix + security questionnaire. Reopen thread if they push dates. :thumbsup:
